task.title: Using Duo Push Multifactor Authentication
task.shortdesc: Using Duo multifactor authentication (MFA) at NC State. Duo ensures that all individuals affiliated with the university are protected from unauthorized access to an NC State unity account.

taskbody.prereq: You must have Duo downloaded onto a personal device before using Duo.
taskbody.context: NC State uses Duo as its MFA system that works to authenticate Unity ID logins. You can authenticate through Duo using Duo Push on a mobile device.

step.cmd: Enter your Unity ID and password.
In the Second Password field, select Push.
step.stepresult: Select OK. You will receive a notification from the Duo app asking if you are attempting to sign in.
